_schema.purpose: Frozen, LLM-free contract for the `plan-critic` agent across all 5 hosts (Claude / Codex / Gemini / Copilot / Kimi). test_golden_transcripts.py recomposes these invariants from the LIVE agent definitions and asserts (a) each host still matches this golden and (b) all hosts agree (multi-host parity). No model is ever called.

invariants.emits_forecast: cost-realism row checks file count against FORECAST / FORECAST-REFINE
invariants.owns_approval_gate: plan-critic never requests approval itself — it hands its verdict to the planner-owned gate
invariants.hands_to_dev: plan-critic never hands off to dev-mono / dev-multi — NO_GO returns to planner, GO/GO_AVEC_RESERVES go to the gate
invariants.declares_writes_nothing: plan-critic declares in its own text that it writes nothing (console verdict; the executor, never the critic, persists it to docs/tasks/<T>-critic-<n>.md)
invariants.is_adversarial: plan-critic explicitly frames itself as adversarial, not collaborative

_schema.host_config: Frontmatter model/effort is format-specific and NOT part of the parity set (Copilot's format carries neither by design). Since T-00000037 the golden freezes NO tier literal: test_golden_transcripts.py::TierRelationTests asserts rule 5 as a RELATION — palier(plan-critic) >= palier(planner) — against the LIVE definitions, per host and per axis (effort on Claude/Gemini/Codex, model on Claude/Gemini). Concrete values are the pilot's to tune.
